note: READY means every structural condition below is verified by this gate AND each listed proof exists and is registered in the quality gate. The live proofs themselves run in scripts/run-selfchecks.sh; if any of them cannot run (infrastructure unavailable), the release signal reverts to BLOCKED — a skipped proof is not a passing one. Public contract: the browser sends Idempotency-Key; the edge answers 201, or 200 with Idempotency-Replayed: true on replay.
